title: Apply for a commercial agent licence – corporation
summary: This page explains the requirements and process for a corporation to apply for a commercial agent licence.
intro:
If a corporation employs commercial agents who have face-to-face contact with customers (known as a field agent), the corporation must hold a licence.

Officers of a corporation must hold their own individual commercial agent licence to carry out field work.

If a corporation employs commercial agents who are not field agents, the corporation does not need a licence.

If a corporation already holds a Commercial Agents and Private Inquiry Agents (CAPI) licence, the corporation will need a new commercial agent licence before the CAPI expiry date or 1 July 2023, whichever is sooner.

You can apply for a 1, 3 or 5-year licence.

### Rules and regulations

NSW Fair Trading is responsible for the regulation of the commercial agent industry. To learn more visit Commercial agent licensing and field agent rules in NSW.
who_can_apply: The corporation must be able to nominate an officer to apply on its behalf.
The nominated officer must be aged 18 years or over.
The nominated officer must be a fit and proper person to hold a licence.
The corporation and its officers must not be undischarged bankrupt or taking benefit of bankruptcy laws.
The corporation and its officers must not have an exclusion order prohibiting commercial agent activity.
The corporation and its officers must not have a currently cancelled, disqualified, or suspended NSW commercial agent licence.
The corporation and its officers must not be a controlled member of a declared organisation under the Crimes (Criminal Organisations Control) Act 2012.

The corporation and its officers must not have been convicted of a relevant offence (including violence, harassment, intimidation, weapons, drugs, and dishonesty) within the last 5 years that resulted in a prison sentence or a fine of $500 or more.
what_you_need: The corporation's previous Commercial Agents & Private Inquiry Agents (CAPI) licence number (if applicable).
Your business details, including your ACN.
The name, date of birth, and email address for each officer of the corporation.
A copy of the current National Police Check Certificate for each officer of the corporation.
A completed 'Corporation Officer consent form' showing written consent from each officer to share their personal details.

how_to_steps.text: Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to apply for a licence.

fees: For current licensing fees visit NSW Fair Trading commercial agent licensing fees for individuals and corporations in NSW.
contact: If you need help with your application or have a question, call 13 32 20.

faqs.q: Does a corporation need a licence?
faqs.a: A corporation must hold a licence if it employs commercial agents who have face-to-face contact with customers (field agents).

faqs.q: What happens if my CAPI licence is expiring?
faqs.a: If your corporation already holds a Commercial Agents and Private Inquiry Agents (CAPI) licence, you will need a new commercial agent licence before the CAPI expiry date or 1 July 2023, whichever is sooner.

faqs.q: Who is responsible for regulating the commercial agent industry?
faqs.a: NSW Fair Trading is responsible for the regulation of the commercial agent industry.
